column5: - `live_contexts_prove_scalar_postcondition` (`checks_contracts_exits.rs:9582`): doc `:9577-9581` says package exit evidence shares it; grep found one use (`:9732`).

- `WholeContractCache` (`checks_contracts_calls.rs:3183`) only holds `contexts` and `answers` (`:3236-3269`). `fact_requirement_mentions` ignores its `_facts` argument (`checks_contracts.rs:10089-10091`). `owned_destination` has an unused `_machine` (`checks.rs:4861`). `storage_place` ignores program, machine and state (`checks_multiplicity.rs:2271-2281`).

- Every `pub(crate)` item in `checks_termination_progress.rs`'s inline modules is used only in that file: 70 matches in 1 file. Its header (`:1-7`) names `machine_summaries.rs` and `fact_subjects.rs`, which exist only as inline modules; `checks_content.rs:14-19` names four files the same way.

- `pub(crate)` wider than reach: crash checks inside private `mod crashes`, 1 caller each (`checks.rs:12115`, `:12120`, `:12133`, `:12139`); `reborrow_resource_drift`, `reborrow_restored_call_use_drift`, `invalid_reborrow_attenuation_diagnostic` internal only (`checks_borrows_resources.rs:2832`, `:852`, `:2964`).

- Debug paths left in: `trace_missing_frontier` reading `OMEGA_TRACE_CLAIM_FRONTIER` (`checks_multiplicity.rs:6704-6814`) and two more reads at `checks_multiplicity_linear_validation.rs:4119`, `:4528` (5 occurrences in 2 files); `eprintln!` under trace flags at `checks.rs:6361-6378`, `:6979-6983`, `checks_borrows_resources.rs:2422`, `:3994`, `:5768`.
- `checks_ranges.rs:10983` discards the result of `immutable_binding_type(invalid)`; purpose not read.
- `finalize_execution` runs part of what the header says (`execution.rs:6-13`): `terminal_debug` and `build_checked_guarded_exit_plans` are called from `published_facts.rs:11255`, `:11249`.
